subject: general
question: Lad Khan Temple at Aihole in Karnataka is an example of which of the following styles of temple architecture?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Vesara __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Lad Khan Temple** at Aihole in Karnataka is an example of the **Vesara** style of temple architecture.
 
• **Vesara**:
 
 
• This is a hybrid style that combines elements of both Dravida and Nagara architecture.
 
• It is characterized by a distinctive roof style and is commonly found in Karnataka.
